## Decisions

- ADR-0001: Item ids are server-generated UUID version 4 strings: `CartStore.add` generates `str(uuid.uuid4())`: a UUID version 4 in canonical lowercase hyphenated form (for example `3f2b8c1e-6d1a-4c53-9a7e-0b5d2f6c8e11`).
